metrics.before_action_target_visible: exact mission target type/color in any of source public image 7x7 before selected action
metrics.before_action_front: exact mission target in original egocentric image[3][5] before action; original direction unchanged on observed pickup effect
metrics.pickup_attempt: selected source action3 only conditional on exact target-front
metrics.observed_effect: selected pickup action3, exact public target in front before, after front exactly empty type1, after original public direction unchanged; do not infer hidden inventory
metrics.attempt_public_after_change: before and after original full public SHA differs, but not proof of target pickup
metrics.selected_history: prior selected action3/4/5 counts and previously observed target pickup effects within the same episode only; no private carried-object state
metrics.comparison: source-authentic successful vs failed action3 target-front attempts across all unchanged roles, per family and role; no counterfactual unselected outcomes
metrics.target_exposure_funnel: per-family/role visible-anywhere frames, exact target-front frames, selected attempt count, actual disappearance, genuine reward-positive terminal, original locked-door openings
metrics.door_effect: locked source public door front state2, selected toggle action5, authentic front after state0 with same color/direction
metrics.source_integrity: verify archive byte SHA, each independent original source digest, all source event before/after digests, episode/event totals, original per-family role metrics and unique identity
metrics.allow_unknown: visible observations cannot establish hidden inventory, successful pickup preconditions, prior object carried, wall coordinates, or physical locomotion

successor: Separate *new* preregistered MG40 DEV ablation of engineered generic pickup/toggle priors and learned-action-effect conventional control vs unchanged native/strong controls, after MG39 evidence qualification. Do not use retrospective MG38 seeds as holdout.
